section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted at a university in Greater London. The sample consisted of 322 female university students with a mean age of 24.72 years and mean BMI of 21.67. The majority of participants (63.7%) were of European Caucasian descent, with smaller proportions of Asian (13.7%), African Caribbean (13.7%), and other ancestry (9.0%).
